official_vs_impostor_test: An account is OFFICIAL for a company iff at least one of three holds -- name alone is NEVER sufficient, because a fan account, a parody or an unrelated same-name entity all pass a name match: (1) the company's own measured web presence (its ir_domain once AMGT-s-4/-b4 resolve one, or a one-pager already on file) LINKS to the account by its exact platform URL; (2) the platform's own verification mark is present on the account at read time; (3) the account's own bio/description names the company's registered domain, checked by the SAME display_link-vs-link discipline the SOURCE rule enforces (lib/research/rules/source.py: match the domain, never a display name or an obfuscated redirect). Any handle entry graduating past UNRESOLVED carries which of the three it satisfied, in its own `evidence` field -- absent that, it is INFERRED, never MEASURED.
